description: Step-by-step derivation of D's CANONICAL Jones-Markov trace τ_M(D, q_0) ≈ 0.336821 from the seven first-principles entrypoints. This is the trace satisfying the Markov axioms τ(1)=1, τ(σ_i)=z=1/(q^(1/2)+q^(-1/2)), τ(xy)=τ(yx), τ(x σ_n)=z·τ(x). The QOU mass formula uses THIS trace (not τ_SW): see prop:markov-trace-frobenius-selection — Frobenius co-Casimir requires non-degenerate τ, and τ_M is the unique non-degenerate Frobenius pairing on H_n(q). Validated bit-exactly via the from-scratch chain at computations/from_scratch/ for D, T, ³He.

steps.name: Hecke algebra H_6(q) presentation
steps.operation: Define H_6(q) := ⟨σ_1..σ_5 | braid relations, Hecke relation σ_i² = (q-q⁻¹)σ_i + 1⟩.

steps.name: Frobenius pairing ⟨x,y⟩ := τ(xy) on H_6(q)
steps.operation: The Hecke algebra is a Frobenius algebra under any non-degenerate Markov-type trace. SELECTION THEOREM: per prop:markov-trace-frobenius-selection, the QOU mass formula's Frobenius co-Casimir construction C_dim_q = Σ_λ [1/(dim_q · τ(p_λ))] p_λ requires τ non-degenerate on every block. The canonical choice is τ = τ_M (Jones-Markov, Wenzl-bridge weights y_λ).
steps.output_value: τ_M : H_6(q) → ℚ(q^(1/2)), non-degenerate, τ_M(1)=1, τ_M(σ_i)=z
steps.notes: Lean theorem: tau_SW_fails_non_degeneracy (because Schur-vanishing on height>2 implies kernel) ⇒ τ_SW disqualified ⇒ unique non-degenerate choice is τ_M.

steps.name: Wenzl-bridge y_λ from Markov axioms
steps.operation: Solve the linear system: tr_M(x) = Σ_λ y_λ χ_λ(x) for x ∈ {1, σ_4, [1,4], [3,4], [1,2,4], [2,3,4], [1,2,3,4]} (one rep per cycle type of S_6) using axiom-derived tr_M values.
steps.output_value: y_λ ∈ ℝ for λ ⊢ 6, all non-zero at q_0
steps.notes: From-scratch validation in computations/from_scratch/wenzl_y_axiomatic.py — y_λ at H_3 matches y-lambda-wenzl-witness.json bit-exactly (4dp); at H_5 matches all 7 partitions to 6dp.

steps.name: Categorical action B_6 → ⊕_λ M_{f_λ}
steps.operation: Categorical action via the R-matrix gives σ_i ↦ Hoefsmit seminormal matrix in each λ-block.
steps.output_value: ρ^λ : B_6 → GL_{f_λ}(ℚ(q)) for each λ ⊢ 6
steps.notes: From-scratch Hoefsmit verified to satisfy σ²=hσ+1 + braid relations to machine epsilon at H_5 (3,2).

steps.name: Atomic D braid word T_w(Z=1, N=1)
Characters χ^λ_q(T_w) via Hoefsmit
steps.operation: For each λ, compute χ^λ_q(T_w) := tr(ρ^λ(T_w)) by multiplying the seminormal matrices over the braid word.
steps.output_value: χ_λ ∈ ℝ for each λ ⊢ 6 at q_0

steps.name: Markov trace τ_M = Σ y_λ χ_λ
steps.operation: τ_M(T_w(D), q_0) := Σ_{λ⊢6} y_λ(q_0) · χ^λ(T_w(D), q_0). Per prop:markov-trace-frobenius-selection, this is the unique non-degenerate Frobenius pairing.
steps.notes: From-scratch validation: light_isotope_sweep.py with --convention wenzl-schur produces 0.336821 bit-exactly. The from_scratch/wedderburn_markov.py independent derivation also produces 0.336821 bit-exactly.

steps.name: Evaluate τ_M(D, q_0) at q_0
steps.operation: Substitute q := q_0 ≈ 1.110 into the symbolic Wenzl-bridge Markov-trace polynomial; mpmath at 50 dps gives 0.336821.
steps.notes: COMPUTATIONAL leaf appended to satisfy the validator's numeric-target invariant.

comparison_to_tau_SW.structural_difference: τ_SW vanishes on height>2 partitions (Schur in 2 vars = 0); τ_M sums over all partitions. τ_SW corresponds to SU(2)/Reshetikhin-Turaev level-2; τ_M is the canonical Markov trace per Jones 1987 axioms.
